scenario_vars.call_intro: I'm calling because your JioHotstar Mobile annual plan is set to end on 1 August, since the UPI AutoPay on it was cancelled.
scenario_vars.content_hook: live cricket and the new Hotstar Specials drops
scenario_vars.offer_text: 5% off if you reactivate before 1 August

ground_truth.offer_summary: 5% off, valid until 1 August. Nothing else is on the table.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi Divya, this is Tara from JioHotstar. I'm calling because your JioHotstar Mobile annual plan is set to end on 1 August, since the UPI AutoPay on it was cancelled. Would you prefer English or Hindi?

turns.speaker: persona
turns.text: Oh, okay, that makes sense. Thank you for calling, that's actually a huge help. English is fine, please.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Got it, English it is. So, what made you cancel the AutoPay earlier?

turns.speaker: persona
turns.text: Oh, right. My bank reissued the card a couple of weeks ago. I completely forgot that would cancel the auto-pay, but I’m so happy I just remembered now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That’s great you remembered! Since you’re reactivating before 1 August, you’ll get 5% off as a loyalty gesture. Would you like to give it another shot?

turns.speaker: persona
turns.text: That sounds like a great deal. Yes, please, let's reactivate the plan.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Awesome! Just open the JioHotstar app, go to your account, and tap 'Renew Now'. The 5% discount is already applied there. No link needed. Shall I wait while you do it?
